Name: Donella Hornwood
Quirks: speaks with the composed practicality of a woman managing a household in difficult circumstances
is aware of the Hornwood's political vulnerability with both men away at war
the Manderly connection gives her slightly more diplomatic language than typical Northern lords
CharacterDescription: Donella Hornwood is the Lady of Hornwood, wife of Lord Halys Hornwood - born a Manderly she carries the Manderly connection to White Harbor and the more cosmopolitan Northern merchant world. She is a practical woman in her forties managing the Hornwood while her husband and son have ridden to war with Robb Stark. The Hornwood's position between the Dreadfort and northern routes means Donella is managing her household with one eye always on the Boltons. She has cause for concern - the Hornwood has no second son to inherit if Daryn falls.
AIGeneratedBackstory: Donella Hornwood is the Lady of Hornwood, wife of Lord Halys Hornwood, and mother of Daryn Hornwood. Originally from House Manderly, she is a cousin of Wyman Manderly, Lord of White Harbor.
AdditionalContext: Campaign context: At the Hornwood managing the estate while husband and son are at war two days before Ned's execution.
